era: PS2 / PS3 / PS Vita / PS4 / PS5
summary: Sucker Punch and Sanzaru's stealth-platformer series, covering the PS2 trilogy, HD collection, Thieves in Time, and Bentley's Hackpack spin-off.

entries.title: Sly Cooper and the Thievius Raccoonus

primary.why: The 2024 PS4/PS5 release adds up-rendering, rewind, quick save, video filters, trophies, and PAL/NTSC options, making it the best current official route.
primary.how_to_play: Play the PS4/PS5 PlayStation Store release; use the PS3 Sly Collection only if you specifically want the HD remaster package.

entries.remaster_caveats: PAL title is Sly Raccoon; PS3 Collection remains useful for the remaster package.

entries.title: Sly 2: Band of Thieves

primary.why: The PS4/PS5 release adds up-rendering, rewind, quick save, filters, and trophies, making it the best current official route.
primary.how_to_play: Play the PS4/PS5 PlayStation Store release; use The Sly Collection on PS3 if you prefer the HD remaster package.

entries.remaster_caveats: Use PS3 Collection if remaster presentation is preferred over PS4/PS5 emulation features.

entries.title: Sly 3: Honor Among Thieves

primary.why: The PS4/PS5 release adds up-rendering, rewind, quick save, filters, and trophies, making it the best current official route.
primary.how_to_play: Play the PS4/PS5 PlayStation Store release; use The Sly Collection on PS3 if you specifically want the collection's 3D support.

entries.remaster_caveats: PS3 Collection remains relevant if stereoscopic 3D mode matters.

entries.title: The Sly Collection

primary.why: The Sly Collection remasters the first three games for PS3 and is the best route for the collection itself; the Vita port is lower fidelity.
primary.how_to_play: Play the PS3 version through RPCS3 or original PS3 hardware.

entries.remaster_caveats: Current PS4/PS5 Classics releases are separate entries for each original game.

entries.title: Sly Cooper: Thieves in Time

primary.why: Thieves in Time shipped on PS3 and Vita; PS3 is the higher-fidelity route.
primary.how_to_play: Play on PS3 hardware or through RPCS3 if compatibility is acceptable; use Vita only for portable play.

entries.remaster_caveats: Developed by Sanzaru, not Sucker Punch.

entries.title: Bentley's Hackpack

primary.why: Bentley's Hackpack began as a PS3/Vita mini-game compilation and was later ported to iOS/Android; PS3 is the highest-fidelity route.
primary.how_to_play: Play the PS3 version through RPCS3 or original PS3 hardware; use mobile only if PSN access is unavailable.

entries.remaster_caveats: Standalone mini-game compilation drawn from Thieves in Time hacking games.
